record.oneLiner: Close is a CRM and sales communication platform providing a comprehensive REST API and an official MCP server with self-serve API keys and OAuth 2.0.
record.verdictReason: Close provides a robust, self-serve REST API authenticated via API keys or OAuth 2.0, along with an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.

evidence.quote:
API Keys — Best for scripts, internal tools, and server-side integrations. Use HTTP Basic Auth with your API key as the username and an empty password.
- OAuth 2.0 — Best for user-facing integrations.
API keys can be created and managed in your Close account under Settings → Developer → API Keys.

Base URL: https://api.close.com/api/v1

Close uses industry-standard REST conventions with predictable URL structures, standard HTTP methods, and JSON request/response bodies.
The MCP server URL is https://mcp.close.com/mcp and has “HTTP Streamable” and “OAuth 2.0 Dynamic Client Registration (DCR)” support.
